newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - March 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - March 17.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on March 17:
WASHINGTON - President Bill Clinton announced a one-day delay of his trip to Helsinki this week to meet Russian President Boris Yeltsin.
WASHINGTON - President Bill Clinton's trip to Helsinki Wednesday begins a hectic schedule of globe-trotting that will take him out of the country five times in the next four months.
WASHINGTON - The Clinton administration plans to propose a major overhaul of the management of the Internal Revenue Service aimed at dealing with years of criticism.
MOSCOW - Russian President Boris Yeltsin has stormed back into control of the Russian government with all the fire and fury of a man determined to have at least one more hurrah.
BEIT SHEMESH, ISRAEL - King Hussein of Jordan visited the families of seven Israeli girls killed by a rogue Jordanian soldier on Thursday, begging forgiveness for the massacre.
WASHINGTON - Supreme Court justices will hear arguments this week over limiting "indecency" on the Internet.
